title: Group OSCORE modules: input-validation consistency (shared secret validator, unwrap TypeError, docstring overclaim)
description: P4 review findings across worker6-9mkj.1/.2 modules. (a) epoch accepts any non-empty secret length (3-byte secret succeeds locally, fails only at distribution) while wrap enforces 16..128/multiple-of-8 - share one master-secret validator. (b) unwrap_group_key raises TypeError (not documented ValueError) when member_wrapped_keys is None/non-iterable - probe-confirmed; WrappedGroupKey arrives from deserialized wire payload; add isinstance(dict) guard raising ValueError. (c) epoch docstring at :163 overclaims: says use .value for vector reason string but PREVIOUS value is previous_in_grace while grace_period_1hr vector reason is within_grace_period; scope the claim to ROLLBACK/FUTURE/GRACE_EXPIRED.
